packagegui.name: dnscryptproxy
packagegui.title: 服務: DNSCrypt Proxy

field.description: These settings have sensible defaults and most users do not need to change them. Only modify if you understand the implications.
始終使用 TCP 傳送上游 DNS 查詢。 啟用 if your network blocks UDP DNS.
可用時對 DNS-over-HTTPS 伺服器使用 HTTP/3（QUIC）。 Can improve performance.
Keep HTTP connections open for this duration. Default: 30

Algorithm for selecting servers when multiple are available.
p2: Power of Two random selection
ph: Power of Two with shuffling
fastest: Always use fastest server
random: 隨機 selection

Wait this long for network connectivity before starting. Set to -1 to disable.
匯入ant for systems where DNS starts before network is ready. Default: 60
Address used to test network connectivity at startup. Default: 9.9.9.9:53
在沒有上游伺服器的情況下執行。 Only cloaking and forwarding rules will work.
Use Oblivious DNS-over-HTTPS servers for enhanced privacy. ODoH separates the resolver from the query, so no single server sees both your IP and your queries.
為每個 DNSCrypt 查詢建立唯一的加密金鑰。 More secure but slightly slower.

field.fielddescr: 停用 TLS 工作階段票證
field.description: Disable TLS session tickets for improved privacy at the cost of slight performance reduction.

伺服器 names to exclude even if they match other criteria (comma-separated).
Example: google, cloudflare-ipv6

field.fielddescr: 憑證重新整理間隔（分鐘）
field.description: How often to refresh DNSCrypt server certificates. Default: 240 (4 hours)
Minimum TTL for NXDOMAIN (non-existent domain) responses. Default: 60
Maximum TTL for NXDOMAIN responses. Default: 600

Response type for blocked queries.
hinfo: Return HINFO record (default, compatible)
refused: Return REFUSED status
empty: Return empty response
TTL for synthetic responses to blocked queries. Default: 10
Rotate log files when they reach this size. Default: 10
Delete log files older than this many days. Default: 7
Number of rotated log files to keep. Default: 1

Enter additional dnscrypt-proxy TOML options not exposed in the UI.
Format: One option per line, e.g. http3_probe = true
Top-level options add keys not available in the UI. If a custom key duplicates a UI-managed key, the UI value takes precedence.
TOML section blocks (e.g. [monitoring_ui]) are appended after the generated configuration. Top-level options must appear before any [section] headers.
The full merged configuration is validated with dnscrypt-proxy -check before saving.
Use the 設定檔 tab to view the complete generated TOML file.
原始 TOML 選項，每行一個。
